Hello, everyone!

The Short Version

Simply A Founder. Not AI Evangelist.

As a tech entrepreneur with core expertise in consumer tech and branding, I’m interested in how an idea becomes something people understand, trust, choose and keep choosing over the alternatives.

That is also my approach to AI:

A model can be technically impressive, but if people do not understand what it is for, trust the result, or see how it fits the task in front of them, being impressive means very little in the end.

“Branding Without Behaviour Change Is Decoration.”

“Technology Without Adoption Is Theatre.”
